title: Palo Alto Networks Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Palo Alto Networks filed an 8-K on April 8, 2026, disclosing three lease amendments extending the company's leases on approximately 940,564 rentable square feet of office space at its Santa Clara, California headquarters for 12 years from August 2028 through July 2040, with base rent of $3.825 per square foot per month and a tenant improvement allowance of up to $72.50 per square foot.
key_points: Palo Alto Networks entered into lease amendments for Building E (290,082 sq ft), Building G (309,559 sq ft), and Buildings F and H (340,923 sq ft) at 3000-3130 Tannery Way, Santa Clara.
The lease term is extended for 12 years from August 1, 2028 to July 31, 2040.
Base rent is abated during the first 12 months of the extended term, then payable at $3.825 per rentable square foot per month with 2% annual increases.
Landlord will provide tenant improvement allowance of up to $72.50 per rentable square foot.
Company has right to further extend leases for two additional periods of 6 years each.
Lease amendments filed as Exhibits 10.1, 10.2, and 10.3 with the SEC.
